## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title: Digital Suraksha AI 
- **Project Slug (must match folder name): digital-suraksha
- **Short Description (1–3 sentences): Digital Suraksha is an AI-powered cybersecurity awareness platform designed to educate users about online fraud, phishing attacks, digital scams and cyber threats.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience: Increasing online fraud, phishing attacks and lack of cybersecurity awareness among internet users.

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:  IBM Db2 Community Edition (Planned Integration).
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution: BM Db2 is proposed to store scan history, user reports, suspicious URLs, file analysis results and security incident records.
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:  Python IBM Db2 driver (ibm_db) – planned.
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed: User records, scan reports, file metadata, URL analysis results, risk scores and incident history.
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration: Configure Db2 connection, create database tables, insert sample scan records, retrieve records and verify scan history through the application.

---

- **Programming Languages:  HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python.
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** 
- **AI / LLM Framework (if applicable): Whisper for speech transcription; rule-based analysis for suspicious content.
- **Model Provider & Model Name (if applicable): OpenAI Whisper Base Model (local speech transcription).
- **Where AI/LLM is Applied in the Workflow: Audio and video speech transcription.

Suspicious message detection.

File and URL inspection.

Risk assessment and classification.

Generating understandable security reports and recovery guidance.

## 6. Submission Verification Checklist

Please verify and check every item before requesting review:

- [x] **Folder Structure:** My submission is placed in a single new directory under `submissions/<project-slug>/` copied from `submissions/_template/`.
- [x] **Naming Conventions:** The `<project-slug>` uses lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, matching the branch name and PR title.
- [x] **Complete Documentation:** Both `submissions/<project-slug>/README.md` and `submissions/<project-slug>/architecture.md` are completely filled out without unfilled placeholder markers.
- [x] **Metadata File:** `submissions/<project-slug>/submission.json` is completed and valid JSON.
- [x] **No Secrets or Credentials:** No API keys, passwords, private tokens, or connection strings with real credentials are committed. `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
- [x] **Tested Setup Instructions:** Setup and run instructions were tested from a fresh environment and can be reproduced by reviewers.
- [x] **License Declared:** Open-source license or distribution terms are specified.
- [x] **Code of Conduct:** All team members agree to adhere to the repository [Code of Conduct](../../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [x] **Scope Isolation:** This PR only adds/modifies files inside `submissions/<project-slug>/` and does not touch root files or other submissions.
- [x] **Google Form Submission:** I understand that opening this PR is step 1, and I will submit this PR URL into the official Google Form (**[GOOGLE_FORM_LINK_TO_BE_ADDED]**).
